decisions.reason: Retaining horizontal scrolling for the mobile pricing table does not change the homepage buttons or their page destinations; the same message's button approval is separate execution evidence already recorded.
The decision about mobile pricing-table scrolling does not affect gallery hover animations; the animation-retention clause is a separate decision already represented in this Requirement.
The source retains the mobile table's horizontal-scrolling interaction without changing package count, square-footage tiers, package prices, or pricing content.
Retaining horizontal scrolling on mobile does not alter which individual services are shown, the diagram format, item selection, or the pricing-transparency requirement.
The mobile pricing-table interaction decision does not change the one-time pricing model or the removal of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The deferred quote calculator is independent of the pricing page's mobile scrolling behavior, and none of its calculation rules or lifecycle state changes.
The pricing-table interaction decision does not change the gallery category tabs or the optional area for other photography.
Retaining mobile pricing-table scrolling has no effect on the homepage hero image emphasis, overlay color, opacity, or visual treatment.
The gallery-photo discussion in the same message is separate from the pricing-table decision, which does not change the requirement to use client portfolio photographs.
The pricing table's mobile scrolling behavior is unrelated to interactive gallery browsing and does not resolve or change the reported gallery glitch.
The source decision does not change the requirement for representative imagery alongside each offered service.
Retaining horizontal scrolling for the mobile pricing table does not alter the site's general visual and image-focused presentation.
